name: video-watch
description: Let Codex actually watch a video file: extracts evenly spaced or scene-change frames with ffmpeg so they can be read as images, plus contact sheets for cheap scanning and burned-in timestamps.

interface.shortDescription: Read a video as frames a model can look at
interface.longDescription: A model cannot open an .mp4. This extracts frames with ffmpeg - evenly spaced, or cut where the picture actually changes - and hands them back as images, with contact sheets so a long recording is a few pictures instead of forty, timestamps burned into the corner so a frame can be pointed at by time, and a JSON manifest of what actually ran. Zero dependencies beyond ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH; nothing leaves the machine.
